description: mods (function hooks, under CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1): the to-human view of the transcript and the kairos button in the prompt footer. to-human-stream.sh (MessageDisplay) draws the same marks while a message streams. kairos: proactive mode — on from launch with KAIROS=1 or mid-session with /kairos, kept across compaction and resume; /kairos off ends it. compact-instructions.md: PreCompact prints it, so every compaction's summary is written as the note a memory-reset self resumes from
